original: ……ふっ
何がおかしい
traducao: What's so funny?

original: いや……。\nそのおかしな仮面を食事中も付けているとは、\n知らなくてな
traducao: Nothing......\nI just didn't know you wore that\nridiculous mask even while eating.

original: 余程、後ろめたい過去でも\nあるらしい
traducao: You must have quite the shameful\npast to hide.

original: ちょっと、リオン！
traducao: Hey, Leon!

original: フン……。\n心に仮面を付けているお前に\nどうこう言われる筋合いはない
traducao: Hmph......\nI don't need lectures from someone\nwho wears a mask over his heart.

original: 何だと……
traducao: What did you say......

original: ま、まあまあ二人とも！
traducao: N-Now, now, you two!

original: えっと……リオンさん？\nすみません、ジューダスは\nいつもこうで……
traducao: Um......Leon?\nI'm sorry, Judas is\nalways like this......

original: カイル。\n余計な事を言うな
traducao: Kyle.\nDon't say anything unnecessary.

original: だって……
フン、不愉快だ
traducao: Hmph, how unpleasant.

original: 行くぞ、ルーティ
traducao: Let's go, Rutee.

original: ちょ、ちょっと……
traducao: W-Wait......

original: ほんと、ごめんなさいね？\nあいつ、いつも無愛想で礼儀とか知らなくて。\n勘弁してやって
traducao: Really, I'm so sorry.\nHe's always cold and has no manners.\nPlease forgive him.

original: ジューダス、……大丈夫？
traducao: Judas, ......are you okay?

original: フン、あんな戯言を\nいちいち真に受ける僕だと思うか？
traducao: Hmph, do you really think I'd take\nsuch drivel to heart?

original: ……おい、○○。\n何を見ている
traducao: ......Hey, ○○.\nWhat are you looking at?

original: フン
traducao: Hmph.

original: えっ？\nちょっと、ジューダス？\n食べないの？
traducao: Huh?\nHey, Judas?\nYou're not going to eat?

original: ごめん、○○。\nオレ、行くね
traducao: Sorry, ○○.\nI gotta go.

original: ジューダス、待ってよー！！
traducao: Judas, wait up!!

original: クエスト「閉じた心、続く未来」が\nエントリーされました。\nジューダスから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: Quest 'A Closed Heart, An Open\nFuture' has been registered.\nYou can accept it from Judas.

original: 待っていたぞ
traducao: I was waiting for you.

original: お前の手を借りるのは不本意だが……。\n中立の立場の人間がいた方が、後々\nいらぬ面倒事を起こさずに済むからな
traducao: Borrowing your help is not ideal,\nbut having a neutral party along\nwill prevent complications later.

original: それと言っておくが、\nこの事は他言無用だ
traducao: And let me be clear:\nthis stays between us.

original: 万一、誰かに漏らす様な事があれば……\nわかっているな？
traducao: If you so much as breathe a word\nto anyone...... You understand?

original: ……話は終わりだ。\n行くぞ
traducao: ......That's all.\nLet's go.

original: フン……。\nここなら人目に付かないと踏んだわけか。\n全く……
traducao: Hmph......\nSo he figured no one would see him\nout here. Honestly......

original: いや……、何でもない。\n先を急ぐぞ
traducao: No......it's nothing.\nLet's keep moving.

original: 何だ。\n何か言いたい事がありそうだな
traducao: What?\nYou look like you want to say something.

original: 事情も知らずに協力は出来かねる……。\nという事か？
traducao: You can't cooperate without\nknowing the circumstances, is that it?

original: フン……。\nまあ、いいだろう
traducao: Hmph......\nFine, have it your way.

original: カイルが、この世界のスタンとルーティに\n自分の両親を重ねている様に\n僕もあいつに、とある人物を重ねている
traducao: Just as Kyle sees his parents\nin this world's Stahn and Rutee,\nI see someone in that man.

original: 無論、言うまでもないが別人だ。\nだが……、奴の言動を見ていると\nどうも気になってな
traducao: He's a different person, obviously.\nBut......watching his behavior\njust gets under my skin.

original: 余計な邪魔の入らない場所で、\n一度話をしてみたいと思っていた
traducao: I wanted to talk to him somewhere\nwithout any interruptions.

original: どうやら、向こうも少なからず\n僕を意識している様だしな
traducao: It seems the feeling is mutual--\nhe's been aware of me as well.

original: そこまで話す義理はない
traducao: I'm not obligated to tell you more.

original: つまらん義理人情で余計な詮索はしない事だ。\nお人好しも度が過ぎると……そのうちお前も\n身を滅ぼす事になるかもしれんぞ
traducao: Don't go prying out of idle sympathy.\nToo much goodwill can destroy you\nin the end.

original: くっ……
勝負あったな。\n質問に答えてもらおうか
traducao: The match is settled.\nNow answer my questions.

original: 誰が、貴様……などに……
traducao: As if......I'd ever......tell you...

original: ……なるほど。\n話の通じる相手ではないらしい
traducao: ......I see.\nYou're not one to reason with.

original: 他人と関わる余裕もない程、\n個人の都合で手一杯と見える
traducao: Too consumed by personal matters\nto spare a thought for others.

original: ……！\n何が言いたい！
traducao: ......!\nWhat are you getting at!?

original: そのままの意味のつもりだが？
traducao: Exactly what I said.

original: …………フン。\nお前に僕の何がわかる？\n知った風な……口を……！
traducao: ............Hmph.\nWhat could you know about me?\nDon't speak......as if you do!

original: ……リオン・マグナス
traducao: ......Leon Magnus.

original: お前はお前が思うより、\n多くのものを手にしている。\nその事を、忘れるな
traducao: You have far more than you\nrealize.\nDon't forget that.

original: 貴様……何を……
traducao: You......what do you......

original: うっ、げほっ、ごほっ
traducao: Ugh, cough, cough......

original: ○○、行くぞ
traducao: ○○, let's go.

original: 放っておけ。\n命に別状はない。\nそれに……
traducao: Leave him be.\nHis life's not in danger.\nBesides......

original: あとは、こいつ自身の問題だ
traducao: The rest is his own affair.

original: 忘れろ
traducao: Forget it.

original: 今回見聞きした事だ。\n全て忘れろと言っている
traducao: Everything you saw and heard today.\nForget all of it.

original: お前は本当に、\n遠慮というものを知らないな
traducao: You truly don't know the meaning\nof restraint, do you?

original: ……そういうところは、\nどこかの馬鹿にそっくりだ
traducao: ......In that way, you're just like\na certain fool I know.

original: とにかく、\n今回の事は他言無用だ。\n……いいな
traducao: In any case,\ntoday's events stay between us.\n......Understood?

original: ……頼んだぞ
traducao: ......I'm counting on you.

original: ……誰だ！
traducao: ......Who's there!?

original: お前は……。\nなぜ、ここにいる
traducao: You......\nWhy are you here?

original: それはこちらの台詞だな。\nなぜ、こんな所で鳩を飛ばしている？
traducao: That's my line.\nWhy are you sending pigeons here?

original: 答える必要はない
traducao: I don't have to answer that.

original: ふっ。\n人に知られて困る相手と通じている……。\nそう解釈されても構わん、という事か？
traducao: Heh.\nCorresponding with someone you can't\nlet others know about, then?

original: ……言っている意味が理解出来んな
traducao: ......I don't follow.

original: 手紙の相手とは、数度に渡って\nやり取りをしているはずだ
traducao: You've exchanged letters with this\nperson multiple times.

original: 時には花や茶葉など、物品の受け渡しを\nしている事も、既に調べが付いている
traducao: Sometimes even sending flowers and\ntea leaves. I've already confirmed it.

original: ……だとしても、お前に何の関係がある
traducao: ......Even so, how is it your concern?

original: フン……。\n寝首をかかれては敵わんからな
traducao: Hmph......\nI'd rather not be stabbed in my sleep.

original: やましい事がなければ、\n素直にそう言えばいい。\nどうなんだ
traducao: If you've nothing to hide,\njust say so.\nWell?

original: 言ったはずだ。\n答える必要はない
traducao: I already told you.\nI don't have to answer.

original: ……これ以上僕を愚弄すれば、\n痛い目を見る事になるぞ
traducao: ......If you insult me further,\nyou will regret it.

original: ほう？\n面白い。\nならば……、力ずくで聞き出すまでだ
traducao: Oh?\nInteresting.\nThen I'll extract the answer by force.

original: やむをえん。\n残念だが、向こうがそれをお望みだ
traducao: It can't be helped.\nIt seems that's what he wants.

original: 構えろ、○○。\n来るぞ！
traducao: Ready yourself, ○○.\nHere he comes!

original: 貴様も懲りないな……。\n何度来ても結果は同じだ
traducao: You never learn......\nNo matter what, it ends the same.

original: それはどうかな
traducao: That remains to be seen.

original: 定まった未来などない。\nそれを今から証明してやる！
traducao: The future is not set in stone.\nI'll prove it to you right now!

original: 行くぞ、○○！
traducao: Let's go, ○○!
